title: Slayte API Credentials
description: Credentials for a Slayte workspace using the Slayte REST API v2 (X-Api-Key authentication).

SiteUrl.title: Workspace Site URL
SiteUrl.description: Your Slayte workspace root URL (e.g. 'https://your-site.slayte.com' or 'https://your-site.slayte.com/api'). Slayte is hosted per workspace with no shared default API host.

ApiKey.title: API Key
ApiKey.description: Primary Slayte API key sent via the X-Api-Key header. Grant read scopes for the surfaces you sync (crm:query, crm:read, committees:read, events:read, directory:read).

QueryApiKey.title: CRM Query API Key (Optional)
QueryApiKey.description: Optional separate Slayte API key with the crm:query scope used specifically for /v2/crm/query/* endpoints when query and REST read scopes are separated across two keys. Defaults to ApiKey when omitted.
